summary: The customer called because they received a bill payment notice due today and could not afford it, asking what to do. The agent verified the customer's identity, checked the account, explained the bill details, and successfully processed a two-week extension for the payment deadline without any extra fees. The call ended politely after confirming the customer's satisfaction.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Check the account and see if a payment extension can be arranged.

commitments.description: Prevent service disconnection and provide an extension deadline until the 20th of the month.
